nodes.name: InstallPackagesUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Member use case that resolves requested package slugs (with access classification) and renders the merged file updates, packmind.json and lock file contents needed to install packages locally via the CLI.

nodes.name: InstallPackagesUseCase
nodes.summary: Resolves packages by slug, classifies them by space access, renders their artifacts per render mode and merges file updates plus config/lock file output for installation.

nodes.name: ListActiveDistributedPackagesBySpaceUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Space-member use case listing packages actively distributed to each target in a space, enriched with deployed standard/command/skill versions, outdated status and release-gate state.

nodes.name: ListActiveDistributedPackagesBySpaceUseCase
nodes.summary: Groups active distribution operations by target and builds per-target active package views including release gate state and outdated artifact info.

nodes.name: toGateSnapshot
nodes.summary: Converts package and release data into a release-gate snapshot for evaluation.

nodes.name: buildActivePackage
nodes.summary: Builds the active package view for a target including deployed artifact info and outdated flags.

nodes.name: groupActiveOpsByTarget
nodes.summary: Groups active distribution operations by target ID.

nodes.name: buildDeployedStandardInfo
nodes.summary: Builds deployed standard info comparing deployed and latest versions.

nodes.name: buildDeployedCommandInfo
nodes.summary: Builds deployed command info comparing deployed and latest versions.

nodes.name: buildDeployedSkillInfo
nodes.summary: Builds deployed skill info comparing deployed and latest versions.

nodes.name: ListDeploymentsByPackageUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Space-member use case returning the distribution history for a given package from the distribution repository.

nodes.name: ListDeploymentsByPackageUseCase
nodes.summary: Fetches distributions for a package in a space after membership checks.

nodes.name: ListDistributionsByCommandUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Use case listing distributions that included a given command (recipe) in an organization.

nodes.name: ListDistributionsByCommandUseCase
nodes.summary: Queries the distribution repository for distributions containing a specific command.

nodes.name: ListDistributionsBySkillUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Use case listing distributions that included a given skill in an organization.

nodes.name: ListDistributionsBySkillUseCase
nodes.summary: Queries the distribution repository for distributions containing a specific skill.

nodes.name: ListDistributionsByStandardUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Use case listing distributions that included a given standard in an organization.

nodes.name: ListDistributionsByStandardUseCase
nodes.summary: Queries the distribution repository for distributions containing a specific standard.

nodes.name: PublishArtifactsUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Core use case that publishes selected standard, command and skill versions to git targets: computes artifact change sets against existing lock files, renders per-agent files, builds commit messages, records distributions and enqueues a delayed publish job.

nodes.name: PublishArtifactsUseCase
nodes.summary: Orchestrates artifact publishing to repositories: fetches versions, groups targets by repository, computes added/updated/removed artifacts, includes default skills, creates in-progress/failed distributions and enqueues the git publish job.

nodes.name: narrowToVersionIds
nodes.summary: Narrows a list of artifact versions to those matching the requested version IDs.

nodes.name: PublishPackagesUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Use case that publishes whole packages (optionally pinned to package release versions) to targets, resolving package content, validating version specs and persisting distributed-package records.

nodes.name: PublishPackagesUseCase
nodes.summary: Resolves package versions per destination, gathers package content and delegates publishing while storing distributed package rows.

nodes.name: PullContentUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Member use case backing CLI pull/install: resolves package slugs, renders artifacts for the configured agents, computes removed and updated packages versus the existing lock file and returns merged file updates.

nodes.name: PullContentUseCase
nodes.summary: Computes rendered content for requested packages, diffs against previously installed packages to emit deletions for removed artifacts while preserving shared ones.

nodes.name: RemovePackageFromTargetsUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Use case removing a package from one or more git targets: resolves artifacts still provided by other packages, renders deletion/update file changes, commits them and records removal distributions.

nodes.name: RemovePackageFromTargetsUseCase
nodes.summary: Prepares removal deployments per repository by fetching lock files and packmind.json, computing artifacts to remove, building a removal commit and creating distribution records.

nodes.name: UpdateRenderModeConfigurationUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Admin use case updating an organization's render mode configuration (which AI agents receive rendered files) after validating requested render modes.

nodes.name: UpdateRenderModeConfigurationUseCase
nodes.summary: Validates render modes and persists the organization's render mode configuration.

nodes.name: UpdateTargetUseCase.ts
nodes.summary: Use case updating a deployment target's name and path, validating inputs and ensuring the git repository and target exist.

nodes.name: UpdateTargetUseCase
nodes.summary: Validates and applies target name/path updates through the target service.
